app.title: Mafia Signs
app.subtitle: Interactive gesture dictionary for competitive Sports Mafia
ui.selectPrompt: Select a gesture to see it demonstrated.
ui.noAnimation: No animation available yet for this gesture.
gestures.citizen.name: Citizen
gestures.citizen.description: Thumbs up, or a light touch of something red — shows you are a Citizen.
gestures.mafia.name: Mafia
gestures.mafia.description: Thumbs down, or a light touch of something black — shows you are Mafia or the Don.
gestures.don.name: Don
gestures.don.description: Mime putting a ring onto your finger — identifies the Don.
gestures.sheriff.name: Sheriff
gestures.sheriff.description: Thumb and index finger form a circle (“OK” shape) — identifies the Sheriff.
gestures.sheriff_self.name: I am Sheriff
gestures.sheriff_self.description: Join index and middle fingers and tap your shoulder, like touching an epaulette — the Sheriff identifies themselves.
gestures.me.name: Me
gestures.me.description: Point your index finger at your own chest.
gestures.you.name: You
gestures.you.description: Point your index finger at another player.
gestures.player_number_1.name: Player 1
gestures.player_number_1.description: Hold up 1 finger on one hand to indicate player number 1.
gestures.player_number_2.name: Player 2
gestures.player_number_2.description: Hold up 2 fingers on one hand to indicate player number 2.
gestures.player_number_3.name: Player 3
gestures.player_number_3.description: Hold up 3 fingers on one hand to indicate player number 3.
gestures.player_number_4.name: Player 4
gestures.player_number_4.description: Hold up 4 fingers on one hand to indicate player number 4.
gestures.player_number_5.name: Player 5
gestures.player_number_5.description: Hold up 5 fingers (open hand) to indicate player number 5.
gestures.player_number_6.name: Player 6
gestures.player_number_6.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 1.
gestures.player_number_7.name: Player 7
gestures.player_number_7.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 2.
gestures.player_number_8.name: Player 8
gestures.player_number_8.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 3.
gestures.player_number_9.name: Player 9
gestures.player_number_9.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 4.
gestures.player_number_10.name: Player 10
gestures.player_number_10.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 5.
gestures.who_is_sheriff.name: Who is Sheriff?
gestures.who_is_sheriff.description: The Sheriff gesture followed by the question gesture — asks who the Sheriff is.
gestures.reveal_role.name: Reveal role
gestures.reveal_role.description: A gesture announcing your actual role out loud.
gestures.checked_red.name: Checked: Red
gestures.checked_red.description: Indicates a checked player came back Red (Citizen).
gestures.checked_black.name: Checked: Black
gestures.checked_black.description: Indicates a checked player came back Black (Mafia).
gestures.unknown.name: Unknown
gestures.unknown.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.vote.name: Vote
gestures.vote.description: A fist with the thumb up, placed or struck on the table — registers your vote.
gestures.vote_for_player.name: Nominate player
gestures.vote_for_player.description: A player-number gesture combined with an upward finger and a tap on the table — proposes a player for voting.
gestures.shoot.name: Shoot
gestures.shoot.description: Fingers held like a gun barrel with a short wiggling motion — signals the night kill.
gestures.next_player.name: Next player
gestures.next_player.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.wait.name: Wait
gestures.wait.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.stop.name: Stop
gestures.stop.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.agree.name: Agree
gestures.agree.description: A nod, or a thumbs up.
gestures.disagree.name: Disagree
gestures.disagree.description: A head shake, or crossed arms.
gestures.together.name: Together
gestures.together.description: Two players show the same handshape side by side to indicate they are on the same team.
gestures.listen.name: Listen
gestures.listen.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.trust.name: Trust
gestures.trust.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.distrust.name: Don't trust
gestures.distrust.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.defend.name: Defend
gestures.defend.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.accuse.name: Accuse
gestures.accuse.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.conflict.name: Conflict
gestures.conflict.description: No documented gesture found for this meaning yet.
gestures.break.name: Break
gestures.break.description: Both palms pressed together, flat, in neutral space — requests a short time-out.
gestures.question_mark.name: Question Mark
gestures.question_mark.description: A hooked index finger, or a question mark traced in the air — a universal question (“what / who / why?”), often combined with pointing at a player.
